CustomField.description: Per-section flag read by Form_Submission_Convert_Upsert_Contact_Overridable and Upsert_Lead_Overridable (Switch_Add_to_Campaign on PageSection.Add_to_Campaign__c). When true, the converted Contact/Lead for this section is added as a Campaign Member to the submission's campaign during conversion. Pairs with the template's campaign and member-status pre-fill values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on so the Contact or Lead created from this section is added as a Campaign Member during conversion. The campaign and member status come from the Form Template's campaign settings; leave off to skip campaign membership for this section.
CustomField.label: Add to Campaign
